paraphrase: Subscription rules (3.1.2): an auto-renewable subscription must give ongoing value, last at least seven days, and work on all the user's devices where the app is available; subscribers should get what they paid for without extra tasks; switching to a subscription model should not remove what existing users already paid for; free trials are configured in App Store Connect; upgrades and downgrades should be seamless and users should not be able to accidentally subscribe twice to the same thing; before asking someone to subscribe, say clearly what the price buys and communicate the Schedule 2 requirements. Apps that scam users or use bait-and-switch are removed from the App Store, and the developer may be removed from the Developer Program.
